claims.summary: The release is grounded in a fresh deployed v0.15.97 UX ZIP/log audit that exported 99/A but trusted six title-only UX false friends as source proof.
UX source filtering rejects celebrity-persona, jazz-album, electronics-prototype, poetry/philosophy-critique, and television-episode false friends.
Source-finder ranking applies the UX weak-source check before new candidates enter mini-shard results while ledger assembly still guards cached mini-shards.
The deep quality grader mirrors the expanded source-sense rule and projects the captured v0.15.97 package to 93/A with six citation P1 findings.
The release explicitly requires fresh v0.15.98 provider proof and carries texture 90 plus the remaining format P2 forward instead of claiming 100/100.
